# CANDIDATE: PRIOR_DAY_VWAP_RETEST_RSI_DIVERGENCE

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price revisiting the prior day's VWAP often finds support/resistance; an RSI divergence at that level signals a high‑probability reversal. This combines mean-reversion at a significant intraday level with momentum confirmation via RSI divergence to filter false retests.

## Mechanism

Identify the prior day's VWAP level (plotted as a horizontal line). When price reaches within 0.05% of that level and forms a bullish (for long) or bearish (for short) RSI divergence (price makes a lower low/higher high while RSI makes a higher low/lower high) on the same timeframe (5‑min), and the candle closes in the direction of the divergence with volume > 1.2× average volume of the last 20 bars, enter at close. Exit shape: Stop beyond the extreme of the divergence candle (e.g., low of bullish divergence candle for long), target 2× risk, then trail remainder with a 10% trailing stop from highest high (long) or lowest low (short). Regime hint: Effective during mid‑day (10:30‑14:00) when intraday volatility is steady; avoid first and last 30 minutes where VWAP noise is high.
